The electrode that faded was the high-speed EB cured acrylate binder sample, cured at 500[1] fpm, with the chamber O2 level as high as 810[2] ppm. Moderate capacity fade was seen up to 100[3] cycles, and the document attributes the capacity fading to this high O2 level, which scavenges the radicals needed for cross-linking.[4]

The electrode that cycled similar to the baseline was the EB cured acrylate binder sample cured at 400[5] fpm, with a much lower chamber O2 level of 182[6] ppm. The document says its pouch cell showed similar cycling performance compared to the baseline process.[7]
